C-RELEASE-0-4-4-337.Summary: Publish Kafedra Planner 0.4.4 from the exact current main, carrying only already merged R1-R9 product changes while proving that the existing simplified full-offline installer, OCR runtime and build-once release path remain deployable.
C-RELEASE-0-4-4-337.Problem: The product changes after v0.4.3 are already merged, but they need a new immutable release. Before publication the current installer and bundle contract must be proven rather than modified speculatively: an ordinary user-owned source directory must work, missing OCR/PDF/Office capabilities must come from the full bundle, OCR rus+eng must pass a real self-test before activation, and the same archive must pass install, update and rollback.

Goals.Goal: Synchronize VERSION, package metadata, current documentation and release notes to 0.4.4 without changing dependencies or SQLite schema 31.
Preserve the existing additive-only offline package contract with Poppler, Tesseract rus+eng, LibreOffice and fonts and no target package version pins.
Prove the existing installer blocks activation when full preflight or OCR self-test fails and leaves the previous release active.

Preserve one version-neutral Release workflow that builds the full archive once and verifies that same artifact through checksum, Debian 12 systemd install, repeated update and forced rollback before publication.
Publish exactly the canonical seven v0.4.4 assets from the verified artifact and verify tag/release/assets through GitHub API.

Constraints.Constraint: No SQLite migration or schema change; schema remains 31.
No dependency graph, runtime version, installer, offline bundle implementation or release workflow change unless an exact-head regression demonstrates a real defect.
Release notes describe only the actual diff from v0.4.3 to the release head.
Real Astra Linux/Debian stable acceptance remains issue 27 and real two-document protocol-profile acceptance remains issue 326.
No version-specific workflow, polling, workflow_run fan-out, temporary release workflow or archive-only follow-up PR.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Add new product functionality, schema, dependencies or deployment architecture during the version bump.
Claim real Astra or real recurring-protocol acceptance from CI fixtures.
Rebuild the release artifact after install/update/rollback verification.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: VERSION, package.json, package-lock.json and current version markers agree on 0.4.4 and docs/releases/0.4.4.md is based on the actual v0.4.3..release-head changes.
config/offline/os-packages.txt contains unzip, Poppler, Tesseract rus/eng, LibreOffice and fonts without target package version pins.
deploy/install-core.sh requires full preflight and ocr.py doctor with rus+eng self-test before activation and explicitly keeps the previous release active on OCR/PDF/Office failure.
scripts/offline/install-from-archive.sh preserves the user-owned source directory and uses safe private root staging without recursive chown of the source.
The existing Release workflow contains exactly one build-full-bundle invocation and passes the same output archive to checksum and systemd-deploy-selftest before Project Control/publication.
No migration 032 is introduced and schema remains 31.
Ordinary exact-head project CI and risk-scoped GRACE pass before squash merge; post-merge main performs only the short smoke.
The exact-main Release run passes project, backup, critical browser, bundle, clean install, repeated update and forced rollback verification.
GitHub Release v0.4.4 is non-draft/non-prerelease, tag points to exact release main and the seven canonical assets are uploaded and non-empty.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head PR CI and GRACE prove the version and release contract; the subsequent exact-main Release run proves the actual built archive and published assets.
